title: The Echoes of Multilinguality: Tracing Cultural Value Shifts during LM Fine-tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Cloze-style testing using probing templates derived from the World Values Survey (WVS) translated into 13 languages, building 'cultural profiles' from model predictions and comparing them to human ground truth data.

Fine-tuning multilingual language models (MLMs) on multi-parallel data in specific languages (Farsi, Korean, Hindi, Russian) and analyzing how the fine-tuning language inadvertently shifts the cultural values encoded in other test languages.

Fine-tuning models on text sources with specific ideological biases (religious texts like the Bible and Quran, and left/center/right-wing news articles) to measure how the data source's bias affects the resulting cross-cultural value shifts.
